criteria.title: Cross-slice relay sets remain distinct
criteria.statement: PSTF evidence maps independent config sources through service-authored NIP-51 relay-set projection and client consumption for browser, ContextVM, and service relay purposes.

criteria.title: Fail-closed and lifecycle paths are evidenced
criteria.statement: Tests and docs cover missing required relay sets, zero accepted OK outcomes, CLOSED/AUTH handling, EOSE-bounded historical catch-up, and no REST fallback after relay acceptance.

criteria.title: NIP-34 and SoulFactory relay boundaries are documented and verified
criteria.statement: Repository operations prefer NIP-34 repository relay hints before global Bahia read relays, and SoulFactory ngit publication relays remain separate from OpenClaw runtime/control relays.

criteria.title: NIP-86 remains an opt-in relay-owner administration boundary
criteria.statement: NIP-86 documentation and tests prove disabled-by-default config, Bahia-owned or Bahia-authorized target checks, payload-bound NIP-98 authorization, and rejection of ContextVM/app mutation methods.

criteria.title: Optional relay metadata and DM work is bounded
criteria.statement: NIP-11/NIP-66 remain advisory metadata only, NIP-51 10050 DM relay-list behavior remains disabled unless a DM feature enables it, and follow-up implementation work is tracked in Beads.

criteria.title: Documentation no longer presents legacy 31974 as current bootstrap
criteria.statement: User-facing setup, rollout, protocol, and command docs present ContextVM discovery 11316-11320 plus NIP-51 30002 relay sets as canonical bootstrap and mention legacy 31974 only as historical or migration inventory.
